_comment: Example 4-cell detection matrix for identity / repeat-registration testing.
Replace placeholder proxy URLs with proxies you legitimately control or have
paid for. profile_id values are arbitrary tags; accounts that share a value
share the same persistent browser profile (cookies, storage, fingerprint).
Expected behavior of a site that detects same-device repeats:
probe-b (same profile + same proxy as A) -> blocked / flagged
probe-c (same profile + new proxy)       -> tells you whether device fp is the signal
probe-d (new profile + same proxy as A)  -> tells you whether IP/ASN is the signal
probe-e (new profile + new proxy)        -> succeed (clean baseline #2)
